## Decisions

- Keep Belor's theme tokens, compact chrome, and existing icon buttons.
- Offer only Full view and Grid view. Select up to six open tabs in the chooser; never create shells when switching views.
- Automatically arrange up to three side by side, four in a 2 by 2 grid, five three above two, and six in a 3 by 2 grid.
- Use a 56px sidebar rail with the shell chooser and command status still accessible.
- Expanding a pane uses Full view; Grid view restores the selected terminals.
- 21st search returned HTTP 401; use existing project primitives without new dependencies.
